tagline.en: Guaranteed lifelong monthly pension between ₹1,000 and ₹5,000 from age 60 until death, based on contributions.

source.quote: Initially available to all citizens of India between 18 and 40 years of age.
With effect from 1st October 2022, individuals paying income tax are not eligible to join the scheme.
Eligibility Criteria: Bank Account, Requirement: Mandatory for auto-debit of contributions

summary.en: Guaranteed lifelong monthly pension between ₹1,000 and ₹5,000 from age 60 until death, based on contributions.

source.quote: Feature: Guaranteed Monthly Pension, Benefit: Lifelong pension between ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 until death

summary.en: Eligible individuals can apply online through net-banking, mobile apps, bank web-portals, or offline by visiting their bank branch where the savings bank account is held.

source.quote: Activating online channels such as e-APY, net-banking, mobile app and bank's web-portal, for easy online onboarding.
